channel.title: My Kind of Town
channel.desc: Ian and Major head to the once-popular seaside resort of Girvan in Ayrshire. Ian has many happy memories of going there as a child and wants to find out how much it has changed. From the more traditional fun of the boating lake and the games arcade, to newer aspects of the town like accessible bicycles and bubble football, there is something for everyone.
